data.description:
SURFACE: /agenda-builder -> select sessions -> 'Review publication' step.

WHAT BREAKS: The review step says 'About to publish N Sessions. Review the exact public fields below. Nothing is visible until you confirm.' Every session row beneath renders clipped to 1-2 characters ('A...' / 'Mo...' / 'Ni...'). The organizer cannot read the title, time, room or speaker that the gate exists to let them verify. The gate still claims it is serving them.

ROOT CAUSE (confirmed by reading live source at 75b871d94c6f):
- src/ui/agenda/agenda.css:15 -> .agenda-publication-candidate { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 20px minmax(0, 1fr); }
- src/ui/agenda/AgendaPage.tsx:502 -> the checkbox is rendered only when NOT in review mode: {!review && <input type=checkbox .../>}
- Therefore in review mode the copy <div> becomes the FIRST grid child and lands in the 20px column.
- src/ui/agenda/agenda.css:18-19 -> that copy has overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap, so it ellipsises at ~1-2 characters.

FIX SHAPE: in review mode either render a placeholder first cell, set grid-column: 1 / -1 on the copy, or switch grid-template-columns to a single minmax(0,1fr) column. One-line CSS/markup change.

WHY URGENT: This defeats a confirmation step on the publish path -- the product's own 'whole loop or nothing' promise -- and a judge publishing sessions walks straight through it. Cheapest high-value fix on the board.

SIZE: small. No dependency.

PROVENANCE: sbek run 2026-08-12T15-33-34, ai-agenda judgement, defects[2]. Validated against live build 75b871d94c6f.
data.title: The publication confirmation gate cannot be read: every field clips to one or two characters

data.body:
Validated by eye against a live `vite dev` (localhost:5251, seeded local D1, demo organizer session), not just green tests.

DROVE: /agenda-builder -> unpublished 4 extra agenda items so the panel had 5 candidates -> checked all 5 -> 'Review publication'.

BEFORE (measured live in the same page by removing the new modifier class from a row): copy column width 20px, title scrollWidth 311px -- exactly the 1-2 character clip the ticket describes. Premise confirmed as filed.

AFTER (shipped markup): 5 review rows, copy fills the row (258px in the narrow pane, 664px wide), title scrollWidth == clientWidth, no clipping. Every row reads title / date+time / room / building / speakers in full, e.g. 'Beyond the Consensus: Navigating AI's Frontier in 2025 -- Mon, Oct 12 at 9:00 AM -- Metropolitan Ballroom -- Sheraton New York Times Square -- Grace Isford'. Screenshot at scratchpad/mrq-135-review-after.png.

NO REGRESSION: back on the select step the row still computes grid-template-columns '20px <rest>' with its checkbox present.

FIX: review rows carry an is-review modifier; CSS collapses them to a single minmax(0,1fr) column and lets the copy wrap instead of ellipsising. Selection-mode CSS untouched.

TEST: tests/unit/publication-review-legibility.MRQ-135.test.ts -- red before the fix (2 of 4 cases), green after.

MACHINE NOTE: load average 200-290 during this run (many agents + zoom). The full vitest run took 580s; 4 integration files hit their own 20s per-test timeouts and all 4 pass when re-run in isolation. None touch agenda or publication code.

Independent review of the diff (fresh headless Claude, read git diff github/main...HEAD plus the surrounding agenda code): VERDICT APPROVE.
- Root cause correctly addressed; is-review applied exactly when the checkbox is dropped.
- Selection mode safe: base rule untouched, class strictly conditional, and the fourth test pins checkbox + two-column template.
- Specificity and both themes fine; only layout properties touched; .agenda-publication-panel overflow:hidden cannot re-clip wrapped copy; no other rule in agenda.css targets this copy.
- Test quality good: reverting either half of the fix fails a test.
- Non-blocking nits only (CSS-reformat-sensitive regex; component exported for the test, which matches repo idiom).

GATE: npm run pr-gate --ticket=MRQ-135 -> every check passed; suite 123 files / 863 tests / 0 failures (that run included the new test). Over the wall-clock objective only (568s vs 120s) at load ~200; the harness itself prints 'the gate is slow, check machine load'.

PR https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/marquee/pull/119 merged to main (squash) at 2026-08-12T20:34Z. Note DEPLOY.md: merging does not ship.

Independent review (fresh headless Claude reading git diff github/main...HEAD plus surrounding agenda code): VERDICT APPROVE. Root cause correctly addressed; is-review applied exactly when the checkbox is dropped; selection mode safe (base rule untouched, class strictly conditional, test pins checkbox + two-column template); specificity and both themes fine; reverting either half of the fix fails a test. Non-blocking nits only.

GATE: npm run pr-gate --ticket=MRQ-135 — every check passed; suite 123 files / 863 tests / 0 failures including the new regression test. Over the wall-clock objective only (568s vs 120s) at machine load ~200; the harness itself says to check load before calling that a defect.

VALIDATED BY EYE on live vite dev (see validation comment + attached screenshot): copy column 20px/clipped -> full width/no clip, all five review rows readable.

PR https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/marquee/pull/119 merged to main (squash) 2026-08-12T20:34Z. Merging does not deploy (DEPLOY.md).
